data.name: Mashruh
data.gender_notes: Mashruh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root sh-r-h which means 'to approve, to agree upon, to decide'. This name signifies a decision or approval that is in accordance with Islamic law, a righteous and approved path in life. The name Mashruh carries the meaning “Approved, Decided, Agreed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashruh usually hope their child will grow to embody approved, decided, agreed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes following the righteous path ordained by Allah.
data.etymology: Mashruh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Approved, Decided, Agreed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mashruh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
